messages:
rachel: kicking off micro-canary for v5-int4-run2 on 0.8% traffic. focus signals: extraction F1, structured field exact-match, latency p95. auto-fallback rules: any F1 drop >2% over baseline for 5m OR structured exact-match drop >1% absolute => immediate rollback.

dave: baseline = v5-fp16-stable? confirm.

rachel: yep fp16 stable. int4-run1 showed tiny latency win but small extraction regressions on nested fields. this run has new quant-calib for head layers.

arun: include slice "nested_forms_deep" (long chains) and bump samples there to 300. also pin big-corp customer to fp16 during test.

rachel: added slice and pin. smoke config: samples: 200 default, nested_forms_deep=300, report_interval=120s, rollback_window=300s.

smoke-bot: run started t=0. cohorts: nested_forms_deep (n=300), short_extract (n=200), long_extract (n=200). will post every 2m.

smoke-bot: t+2m: extraction_f1 delta = -0.9% (ok), structured_exact delta = -0.4% (ok), latency_p95 = -6% (good). no triggers.

dave: good. watch for drift in nested_forms_deep; int4 sometimes loses subtle tokenization biases.

smoke-bot: t+6m: nested_forms_deep extraction_f1 delta = -2.3% -> exceeds 2% threshold. triggering immediate rollback and posting 5 sample diffs to secure blob.

arun: ack. reduce int4 fraction to 0.0 and open ticket to triage quant-calib for head layers + tokenizer alignment check.

rachel: rolling back, samples in blob. follow-ups: 1) revert new head-calib in next build 2) run targeted offline sim on nested_forms_deep n=5k 3) add a transient guard to block any auto-promote of int4 variants for 12h after an extraction rollback.

dave: also schedule quick retest with adjusted tokenization mapping; might be cheap to validate offline.

rachel: will coordinate. summary: micro-canary rolled back due to nested_forms_deep extraction F1 -2.3%. rollback applied, pins and diffs recorded. will post postmortem notes after triage.
